card.name: Start of titrate in dosing instructions
card.fires_on: The first piece of the word titrate (tit before rating or ration) in dose-adjustment instructions. It also fires weakly on a few other dose-adjustment words such as determined after as, or the unit mcg.

modes.label: Titrate split word
modes.description: The opening piece tit of titrate, titration or titrated.

modes.label: Dose-change wording
modes.description: Other words or units inside dose-change instructions, such as determined or mcg.
modes.example: 45 mg once daily based on glycemic response as<< determined>> by HbA1c.
